name: inbox-goalie
description: Guard your inbox with paid priority requests for unsolicited senders.

interface.shortDescription: Make unsolicited senders pay for priority
interface.longDescription: Inbox Goalie helps you route unsolicited email into Requests and gives senders an optional paid path to priority. Payment never guarantees a read or reply.
defaultPrompt: Set up Inbox Goalie for me at $10 per priority request.
Review my unread email and tell me which messages you would Goalie.
Goalie this email and give me the reply.
